remarks: HUGE tri-level townhome in a quiet 4-unit complex- most pets welcome! This spacious unit features oversized bedrooms with built-in closet organizers, hardwood floors, and a modern kitchen with granite counters and stainless appliances. The massive finished lower level is perfect as a second family room, office, or even a 3rd bedroom. Tons of storage, recessed lighting, crown molding, and a private deck. Just 6 minutes to Stamford train, 3 minutes to Cummings & Cove Island Parks/Beaches. ShopRite is about 2 minutes away. This unit includes 2 parking spots, laundry, and all-new mechanicals. Bright, open, and move-in ready-this is one of the largest rentals you'll find!
